reqs.title: CSV Export
reqs.body: The system shall export the needs set to a CSV file, validating the configured column headers, mapping need fields to columns, and writing one row per exported need.
reqs.raw_rst:
.. feat:: CSV Export
   :id: FEAT_csv_export
   :status: draft

   The system shall export the needs set to a CSV file, validating the configured column headers, mapping need fields to columns, and writing one row per exported need.

member_updates.raw_rst:
.. comp_req:: Validate CSV header row
   :id: CREQ_csv_validate_headers
   :status: recovered
   :satisfies: FEAT_csv_export

   The CSV Exporter shall reject an export request when the configured column mapping references a header not present in the target schema.

.. comp_req:: Map need fields to CSV columns
   :id: CREQ_csv_map_columns
   :status: recovered
   :satisfies: FEAT_csv_export

   The CSV Exporter shall map each need field named in the column mapping to the corresponding CSV column in the emitted row.

.. comp_req:: Write one CSV row per need
   :id: CREQ_csv_write_rows
   :status: recovered
   :satisfies: FEAT_csv_export

   The CSV Exporter shall write exactly one CSV row per exported need, in the order returned by the needs query.
